releases.notes:
### 新增

- **InventoryTweaks · middle click**：在拍卖浏览器、宠物、社区商店等界面，把槽位的左键点击改为中键点击，免去高延迟下"拿起物品"动画造成的操作拖慢；
- **EnchantLore · missing enchants**：按住快捷键即可在物品说明里列出该物品缺失的附魔。

### 改进

- **ClickGUI**：重做模块分类，把视觉与摄像机相关模块归入 Render——CameraNoClip 与 NoHurtCam 合并为 **CameraTweaks**，NoSwimPose、SoftFullscreen 移入 Render，PrismBreak 移入 Misc；**Nodebuff** 更名为 **NoDebuff**（旧配置会自动迁移）；
- **InventoryTweaks**：并入 RemoveRecipeBook 与 SidePanel，物品栏相关功能统一收纳到该模块下；
- **EnchantLore**：附魔数据改为直接取自 **SkyblockAddons** 维护的数据集，方便跟上后续数据更新；
- **ModernTooltip**：smoothtooltip 不再每帧重复测量全部提示文本，降低查看物品时的帧数开销；
- **SidePanel**：写盘时不再逐件深拷贝缓存的物品，进一步消除周期性的主线程卡顿；
- 改变了 kat reminder 的取消提示样式，改为与同步提示一致的 *[Error alert?]* 链接。

### 修复

- 修复 commands keybind 新绑定的按键组合在保存后不生效、必须重启客户端的问题；
- 修复 /showitem 的聊天悬停提示中不渲染附魔说明的问题，现在与物品说明保持一致。

---


### Added

- **InventoryTweaks · middle click**: turns slot left-clicks into middle-clicks in the Auction Browser, Pets, Community Shop and similar menus, so the "pick up item" animation no longer slows you down on high ping;
- **EnchantLore · missing enchants**: hold the shortcut to list the enchants an item is missing in its tooltip.

### Improved

- **ClickGUI**: reworked the module categories, moving the visual and camera modules into Render — CameraNoClip and NoHurtCam merged into **CameraTweaks**; NoSwimPose and SoftFullscreen moved to Render; PrismBreak moved to Misc; **Nodebuff** renamed to **NoDebuff** (old configs are migrated automatically);
- **InventoryTweaks**: RemoveRecipeBook and SidePanel merged into it, so the side panel features now live under this module;
- **EnchantLore**: enchant data now comes from the dataset maintained by **SkyblockAddons**, making future data updates easier;
- **ModernTooltip**: smoothtooltip no longer re-measures every tooltip line each frame, cutting the frame cost of looking at items;
- **SidePanel**: the cache no longer deep-copies every item when writing to disk, further removing the periodic main-thread stutter;
- Fixed the kat reminder cancel prompt, now an *[Error alert?]* link matching the sync prompts.

### Fixed

- Fixed newly bound key combos in commands keybind not working until the game was restarted;
- Fixed the /showitem chat hover tooltip not rendering the enchant lore; it now matches the item tooltip.

**增加了:**
-Safari Zone 的一系列esp高亮 ---by @alexeys1 in https://github.com/raueyhs/Baity/pull/14
-ModernTooltip:tooltip切换动画和滚动浏览；
-AutoSprint 强制疾跑 ---by @alexeys1 in https://github.com/raueyhs/Baity/pull/19
-PrismBreak 方块破坏描边 ---by @alexeys1 in https://github.com/raueyhs/Baity/pull/20
-RemoveRecipeBook 移除配方书 ---by @alexeys1 in https://github.com/raueyhs/Baity/pull/21
**修改了:**
-修复潜影贝高亮在galatea失效的问题；
-修复和优化了Keybinds功能；
-修改了SidePanel的图标；
-扩展了小人的生效对象范围(大致包含各种情况下的替身)；
-修复了由取消游泳视角变化(NoSwimPose)和旧版蹲起高度(OldSneaking)导致的睡觉视角高度问题；
-优化了ClickGUI的滚动和展开动画；
-使纸娃娃的表现联动NoSwimPose；
**其他:**
-内化了**owo-lib**的部分逻辑以取消其作为前置模组的条件.

---

**Added:**
-Safari Zone esp ---by @alexeys1 in https://github.com/raueyhs/Baity/pull/14
-ModernTooltip:tooltip switch animation and scrolling;
-AutoSprint ---by @alexeys1 in https://github.com/raueyhs/Baity/pull/19;
-PrismBreak:breaking progress overhaul ---by @alexeys1 in https://github.com/raueyhs/Baity/pull/20
-RemoveRecipeBook ---by @alexeys1 in https://github.com/raueyhs/Baity/pull/21
**Modified:**
-fixed the issue where shulker highlight fails in galatea;
-fixed and optimized the Keybinds function;
-modified the icon of SidePanel;
-expanded the range of effective objects for SmolPeople (roughly including stand-ins in various situations);
-fixed the issue of sleeping angle height caused by NoSwimPose and OldSneaking;
-optimized the scrolling and unfolding animations of ClickGUI;
-made the performance of the paper doll interact with the NoSwimPose;
**Misc:**
-part of the logic of **owo-lib** has been internalized to remove its condition as a premodule.
